title: Email suspension banner must render on every messaging scene
answers: Where is the email sending suspended banner?
Suspended project doesn't see banner on broadcasts page
Adding a new sending surface: what banners are required?
body: The suspended-email banner is the shared component products/workflows/frontend/EmailSuspensionBanner.tsx (reads `workflowsEmailSuspensionLogic`, keeps data-attr `workflows-email-suspended-banner`). Any scene that sends email (WorkflowsScene, BroadcastsScene) must render `<EmailSuspensionBanner />` under the title section, otherwise suspended projects get no warning there. Do not inline a copy of the banner; copy names both workflow and broadcast emails.
applies: scenes in products/workflows that send email
says: Email suspension warning does not appear on broadcast sending page
Suspended project can send broadcasts without seeing suspension warning
How to ensure suspension banner shows on all email sending screens
New email sending surface missing suspension banner by default
search: The EmailSuspensionBanner component (products/workflows/frontend/EmailSuspensionBanner.tsx) must be rendered on every scene that sends email (WorkflowsScene, BroadcastsScene) to warn suspended projects. Render the banner under the title section; do not inline a copy of the component as it provides unified warning for both workflow and broadcast emails. The component reads workflowsEmailSuspensionLogic and maintains data-attr workflows-email-suspended-banner. Applies to all messaging scenes in products/workflows/frontend that handle email sending.
